tab_storm
‘ptotC’ = Stationary conditions / Control Climate

‘ptotS’ = Step Change (increase/decrese) in observed wetness ‘ptotT’ = Progressive Trend (positive/negative) in observed wetness

‘stormsC’ = Stationary conditions / Control Climate ‘stormsS’ = Step Change (increase/decrese) in observed storminess’ ‘stormsT’ = Progressive Trend (positive/negative) in observed storminess’

‘n/a’ = scenario NOT DEFINED (as both xxx_SC & xxx_SF differ from 0)
